e.title: MBBEFDLite
e.summary: MBBEFD 分布族统计函数（CRAN 1.0.0，零依赖）：概率/分位/随机数/矩估计——保险曝光曲线与 ILF 建模
e.summary_en: MBBEFD distribution family (CRAN 1.0.0, zero-dependency): pmf/cdf/quantile/rng/moment fitting — exposure curves and ILF modelling
e.summary_hk: MBBEFD 分佈族統計函數（CRAN 1.0.0，零依賴）：概率/分位/隨機數/矩估計——保險曝光曲線與 ILF 建模
e.body: MBBEFDLite（CRAN 1.0.0，2026-03 发布）提供 MBBEFD（Maxwell-Boltzmann-Bose-Einstein-Fermi-Dirac）分布族的统计函数：概率质量、分布、分位数、随机数生成、矩估计拟合——Bernegger（1997）在保险建模中的经典分布族，零外部依赖。对 RIAA：MBBEFD 是责任险/再保险定价的基础分布——[[insurance-ilf]]（burning-cost 的 MBBEFD 曝光曲线实现，pool 中）管完整工作流、本包是零依赖的分布函数基础；曝光曲线决定「限额越高费率密度越低」的量化；与 [[reinsurance]] 视角配套；适合限额定价与再保险方向。
e.body_en: MBBEFDLite (CRAN 1.0.0, published 2026-03) provides statistical functions for the MBBEFD (Maxwell-Boltzmann-Bose-Einstein-Fermi-Dirac) distribution family: probability mass, distribution, quantile, random variate generation and method-of-moments fitting — the classical family for insurance modelling from Bernegger (1997), with zero external dependencies. For RIAA: MBBEFD is foundational for liability/reinsurance pricing — [[insurance-ilf]] (burning-cost's MBBEFD exposure-curve workflow, in pool) handles the full workflow, this package is the zero-dependency distribution-function base; exposure curves quantify 'higher limits, lower rate density'; pairs with the [[reinsurance]] view; suits limit pricing and reinsurance.
e.body_hk: MBBEFDLite（CRAN 1.0.0，2026-03 發佈）提供 MBBEFD（Maxwell-Boltzmann-Bose-Einstein-Fermi-Dirac）分佈族的統計函數：概率質量、分佈、分位數、隨機數生成、矩估計擬合——Bernegger（1997）在保險建模中的經典分佈族，零外部依賴。對 RIAA：MBBEFD 是責任險/再保險定價的基礎分佈——[[insurance-ilf]]（burning-cost 的 MBBEFD 曝光曲線實現，pool 中）管完整工作流、本包是零依賴的分佈函數基礎；曝光曲線決定「限額越高費率密度越低」的量化；與 [[reinsurance]] 視角配套；適合限額定價與再保險方向。
e.verified_note: CRAN 官方页面核实（v1.0.0，MBBEFD 族/Bernegger 1997），未实测
